messages:
Jen K: quick check-in — pushed an updated compact threshold + suppression preview frame to Figma: https://figma.com/s/placeholder Jen K: main questions: placement of the threshold label (left vs inline), whether suppression preview should show fallback channels inline, and microcopy for the mute pill Matt L: saw it, looks cleaner overall. left-aligned labels feel denser which is good for compact lists Matt L: a11y nit — the mute pill low-contrast outline might fail AA at small sizes Priya S: agree on contrast. also need to confirm keyboard order when opening the preview modal (focus should land on first actionable control) Aria (a11y): +1. please add an aria-live region for the preview summary so screen readers get the state change when toggling suppression Jen K: sketch for aria-live: ```
Channels muted: email, pagerduty (will fallback to slack)
``` Jen K: copy ideas: current 'suppress for' vs 'silence for' vs 'mute for' — which reads best in the UI? Priya S: prefer 'Temporarily mute these channels for 1 hour' — explicit and user-friendly Matt L: infra folks might read 'mute' as permanent; maybe 'Temporarily silence' but that’s wordy. Leaning to 'Silence for 1 hour' Aria (a11y): whichever term we pick, ensure tooltips explain consequences (e.g., 'Silence: suppress notifications but keep incident active') Jen K: another UX question: should preview show the computed fallback channel in-line (e.g., Slack -> Email) or only show it on hover? I worry inline may clutter compact views Matt L: inline is useful for quick triage. maybe collapse it under a chevron so default stays tidy and power users can expand Priya S: agree, collapse by default. also add a 1px divider between threshold rows to help scanning in dense lists Jen K: noted. action items: 1) update Figma with keyboard flow and collapsed fallback state 2) run quick contrast check and adjust mute-pill border 3) copy decision: team to decide between 'Silence' vs 'Mute' — leaning 'Silence' 4) Aria to propose aria-live snippet for final review designbot: preview build created for branch feat/compact-suppress-preview — staging link: https://staging.internal/preview/1234 Matt L: will test staging for focus order and keyboard nav later today Priya S: I'll draft the copy PR with both variants and include context for localization implications Jen K: thanks — looping @design-reviews for follow-up when Figma is updated. :thumbsup: Matt L: thanks all.
